inference: none; each named graph queried separately; no OWL premise, remote SERVICE, entailment or normalization
limitations: All answer fixtures are synthetic author tests; this does not replace independently prepared literature data or expert acceptance.
Queries retrieve asserted graph bindings without identity normalization, inference, managed-record conformance or truth adjudication.
Supplementary numeric/provenance/revision metadata are explicitly separate from the original OWL; native-only adequacy gaps remain recorded.
A mutated query must run successfully and disagree with the fixed positive oracle; parser errors do not count as detected mutations.
No HermiT, SHACL or 674-row planning baseline result is rewritten or increased by this query run.
population: Author-created synthetic/adversarial RDF records; no independent or literature-data acceptance is inherited.
